I will keep this small beans plot mostly the way I manage it in a normal season, because cash is tight and 0.15 hectare does not justify buying a full fertilizer bag. Since I own the plot, I will put on some manure/compost if I have it, and I will use improved bean seed if I can get a small packet from the agro-dealer because I have seen other farmers get better harvest with it. I will not irrigate, and I will do the work with my household labor unless we fall badly behind.
